title: ProviderDynamicCapabilities
$comment: streamingAvailable and cancellationAvailable are tri-state on purpose: true, false, or absent. Absent means 'inherit the static declaration' and is a distinct state from both booleans. They must never become nullable: null would be a fourth state no consumer handles, and bridges omit the key specifically to preserve 'absent'.
description: A provider's live capability check, evaluated on the current host when routing or when checkCapabilities() is called. Unlike the descriptor it can change between calls.

available.description: Whether the provider is available and functional on this host right now.

reason.description: Why the provider is unavailable, when available is false.

streamingAvailable.description: Whether the provider can stream (Mode 2) on this host right now. Absent inherits the static descriptor.supports.streaming value; only set it when the host takes streaming away from a provider that otherwise declares it. Never null.

streamingUnavailableReason.description: Why streaming is unavailable, when streamingAvailable is false. Absent lets the route planner synthesize a default message.

cancellationAvailable.description: Whether cancellation is honored on this host right now. Absent inherits the static descriptor.cancel value: any value other than 'none' means available. Never null.

taskCapabilities.description: Per-task overrides of the provider-level check, for tasks whose availability differs on this host, e.g. a voice that is not installed. Every field of an entry is optional and absent inherits the provider-level value; a false at either level wins.

taskAvailability.title: ProviderTaskAvailability
taskAvailability.description: The live check for one task kind.

kind.description: The task kind this entry describes.

available.description: Whether the task can run on this host right now. Absent inherits the provider-level available. Never null.

reason.description: Why the task is unavailable, when available is false.

streamingAvailable.description: Whether the task can stream on this host right now. Absent inherits. Never null.

streamingUnavailableReason.description: Why streaming is unavailable for this task, when streamingAvailable is false.

cancellationAvailable.description: Whether cancellation is honored for this task right now. Absent inherits. Never null.

readiness.description: How ready the task is to run. Absent means 'ready'. With available false, 'not_prepared' or 'preparing' means 'not yet' rather than 'not on this device'; this entry then decides even when the provider-level available is false.

locales.description: BCP 47 locales available for this task right now. Absent means the provider cannot enumerate them.

voices.description: Every voice available for this task right now, one entry per voice. Absent means the provider cannot enumerate them; a request that requires a voice then never routes to it.

controlStates.description: The live state of each declared speech control for this task (ADR 025), at most one entry per id and delivery. A voice's own controlStates override these for that voice. A control and delivery with no entry are in the unknown state.

controlState.title: SpeechControlState
controlState.description: Whether one speech control works right now on one output delivery, and with which values (ADR 025). Entries are keyed by id and delivery: a list holds at most one entry per pair, and a provider whose playback and artifact paths differ states each. Absent available means unknown, and unknown is never support: a control satisfies a request only with available true and, for a number, a known range that contains the value. On a voice, every field present overrides the task's entry with the same id and delivery for that voice. playback.volume only ever has a 'playback' entry.

available.description: Whether the control works. Absent means unknown. Never null.

reason.description: Why the control does not work, when available is false.

range.title: SpeechControlRange
range.description: The values a number control accepts, in the shared control's units. On a voice it replaces the task's range.

default.description: The value the provider uses when the request names none.

step.description: An increment for a settings slider. A hint, not a quantization rule.

voice.title: ProviderVoice
voice.description: One available voice: its provider-neutral traits, and an id and name for an application that lets someone choose it.

id.description: Identifies this voice within its provider, for use as speech.voice.id with speech.voice.providerId. Opaque: stable on this device while the voice stays installed, and meaningful nowhere else. Absent when the provider cannot address single voices.

name.description: Label for showing the voice to a person, as the platform reports it. Not unique and not localized; never compare it.

locales.description: Every BCP 47 tag the voice speaks; may repeat `locale`. A request's locale matches `locale` or any entry here.

networkRequired.description: Whether using the voice sends data off the device. Absent inherits the task's privacy posture.

readiness.description: How ready the voice is to speak. Absent means 'ready'.

controlStates.description: Sparse overrides of the task's controlStates for this voice (ADR 025), matched by id and delivery. A pair with no entry inherits the task's state for that pair; available false disables the control for this voice on that delivery; a range replaces the task's range for that delivery.

readiness.title: ProviderReadiness
readiness.description: How ready something is to run (ADR 019). 'ready': it runs now at full speed. 'cold': it runs now, but its first run is slow. 'not_prepared': it cannot run until prepare() has run. 'preparing': it is being prepared now and cannot run yet.

voiceGender.title: VoiceGender
voiceGender.description: Perceived gender of a voice, as the platform reports it.
